descriptions.zh: [beholder_planet.GetName]上的金字塔已不复存在，原地留下了一个巨大的空洞。当地的未开智生物满脸困惑地站在空洞的峭壁边上。
descriptions.en: The Monolith on [beholder_planet.GetName] has vanished, leaving a giant crater in its wake. The pre-sapient inhabitants line the precipice, seemingly confused.

options.script: name = UNFORTUNATE

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们标记出了[From.GetName]上能量波动的源头，它源自一座位于未开智生物领地中心的金字塔形建筑。我们发现当地人口怪异地聚集在建筑周围。

我们若想要确认该物体的功能，则无可避免地会与这颗行星的居民打交道。
descriptions.en:
We have pinpointed the source of the energy fluctuations on [From.GetName] to a monolithic structure in the heart of the pre-sapient territory. The local population have been observed curiously congregating around the structure.

If we are to ascertain the purpose of this object, interaction with the planet's inhabitants is inevitable.

label.en: Send down a team to begin investigations.

label.zh: 我们还有更重要的事要处理。
label.en: We have more important matters to focus on.

options.script: name = paragon.3.b

descriptions.zh:
我们的团队开始着手调查[From.From.GetName]上的建筑。它是一座古老的四棱锥结构。科学家汇报在它的周围区域会听到怪异的低语，因此恰如其分地称之为“低语方尖碑”。

这座金字塔似乎在这个星球上的未开智物种所呈现的基本信仰系统中起着不可替代的作用。一个在这种智慧等级的物种甚至还没有开始使用工具时，却在发展复杂的精神实践，这是非比寻常的。

[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]领地意识很强，而且很容易被激怒。我们的到来打扰到了他们，越来越多的生物聚集到了金字塔附近。我们可能需要一些强制措施才能靠近这座建筑了。
descriptions.en:
Our team has begun investigating the structure on [From.From.GetName]. It is an ancient four-sided pyramid. Scientists report hearing strange whispers in its vicinity and have aptly named it the 'Murmuring Monolith'.

The Monolith appears to play an integral part in a rudimentary belief system observed by the planet's pre-sapient species. It is unusual to witness a species at this level of sentience developing complex spiritual practices when they have yet to begin using tools.

The [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] are territorial and easily provoked. Our arrival has disturbed them, and more have begun gathering around the Monolith. Gaining access to the structure will require force.

label.zh: 我们必须博得他们的信任。

tooltips.zh: 我们会教会这些未开智物种崇拜我们。
tooltips.en: We will teach this pre-sapient species to worship us.

tooltips.zh: 我们会教会这些未开智物种崇拜我们。
tooltips.en: We will teach this pre-sapient species to worship us.

label.zh: 他们不构成威胁。不理会就行。
label.en: They pose no threat. Leave them alone.

descriptions.zh:
在与[beholder_planet.GetName]上的[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]共处了一段时间后，他们不再那么害怕我们了。我们对其社会结构建立了基本的理解。

新的一群[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]开始涌向金字塔。与最初的保卫领土的行为相比，它们现在似乎很平静，甚至有所期待。有什么事情要发生了。
descriptions.en:
After spending some time with the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] on [beholder_planet.GetName], they appear less frightened by us. We are building a basic understanding of their social structures.

A fresh influx of [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] have begun crowding the Monolith. In contrast with their initial territorial behavior, they now seem to be calm, and even anticipatory. Something is about to happen.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经驯化[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]将我们视为神明。他们现在温顺可欺并向我们寻求庇佑。我们非凡的科技在它们眼中无异于魔法，操纵他们的信仰体系简直信手拈来。我们现在可以自如地前往低语金字塔了。
descriptions.en: We have trained the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] to look at us as deities. They are now domesticated, and reliant on us for safety and protection. Our technological prowess is like magic to them, and manipulating their belief system was an easy task. We now have full access to the Murmuring Monolith.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 我们试图驯化[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]，本以为将他们的信仰从金字塔转向我们是轻而易举的事情。不幸的是我们的尝试适得其反，激起他们激烈的反抗。一个巨大的群体开始包围起低语金字塔。我们仍无法接近。
descriptions.en: We attempted to domesticate the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj], assuming we would make short work of refocusing their worship from the Monolith to us. Unfortunately our attempts have backfired, and we have provoked an aggressive response. A great crowd has appeared to blockade the Murmuring Monolith. We cannot gain access.

label.zh: 真不幸。强行清除这片区域。
label.en: Unfortunate. Clear the area by force.

descriptions.zh: 在粗暴的火力展示后，我们让[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]被迫意识到我们的优越性。尽管在智力上存在巨大的鸿沟，他们还是吸取教训，明白挡我们的路不符合它们的最佳利益。许多人吓得落荒而逃，回到它们的巢穴中。现在我们可以不受干扰地研究低语金字塔了。
descriptions.en: After a bold display of firepower, we have forced the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] to recognize our superiority. Despite the gulf between our intellects, they have absorbed the lesson that it is not in their best interest to stand in our way. Many have fled in fear, retreating to their dwellings. The Murmuring Monolith can now be examined without interference.

label.zh: 我们就是做了一些必要的事罢了。
label.en: We did what we had to do.

options.script: name = paragon.15.a

descriptions.zh:
我们对低语金字塔的研究看来相当耗费时间，而且所获无几。它的秘密仿佛在和我们玩捉迷藏一样。毫无疑问这座四棱锥里一定有什么先进的科技，但它产出的庞大能量以我们目前的科学理解而言是非常怪异的。

在金字塔的外墙之内一定发生着什么特别的事情。新的一群[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]开始涌向金字塔。与最初的保卫领土的行为相比，它们现在似乎很平静，甚至有所期待。有什么事情要发生了。
descriptions.en:
Our study of the Murmuring Monolith has proven time consuming and less revealing than we anticipated. The structure's secrets elude us. There is undeniably advanced technology within the pyramid, but the sheer amount of energy being produced is inconsistent with our current understanding of science.

Beyond the walls of the Monolith, something unusual is going on. A fresh influx of [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] have begun crowding the Monolith. In contrast with their initial territorial behavior, they now seem to be calm, and even anticipatory. Something is about to happen.

descriptions.zh: 当所有的[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]都聚集到了低语金字塔周围时，我们观测到了一个前所未见的现象。一种冷静的感觉一瞬间在兽群中涤荡开。这些生物仿佛被什么看不见的力量定住了。我们的一些科学家也被这一不寻常的现象影响，短时间失去了与现实的关联。当他们回过神来时称，他们与那座低语金字塔发生了直接的对话。
descriptions.en: As all the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] gathered around the Murmuring Monolith, we observed a phenomenon unlike anything we have previously encountered. A sense of calm washed over the crowd. The creatures were transfixed by an invisible force. Some of our scientists were caught up in this paranormal event, and for a moment, lost touch with reality. When they came to, they claimed to have communed directly with the Murmuring Monolith.

descriptions.zh:
来自我们科学家的关于最近与低语金字塔发生沟通的汇报相当地耐人寻味。据说，这样的通灵经历能让人感受到解放和转变。

科学家将这一事件称为“低语呢喃”，并坚称是那座金字塔直接与他们沟通的。在短暂的接触期间，参与者可以共享他们内心最深处的想法，并被信任和理解的感受所包裹着。

当这一效应结束时，金字塔的能量输出骤降。也许我们应该找到一种重新与金字塔建立联系的方法。
descriptions.en:
The report from our scientists regarding the recent communion with the Murmuring Monolith makes for an interesting read. Supposedly, the ordeal was a liberating and transformative experience.

The scientists now refer to the event as 'The Murmuring', and maintain that the Monolith made direct contact with them. In the brief moment of contact, the participants were able to share their innermost thoughts with all involved, and were overcome by a sense of trust and understanding.

When the effects faded, the Monolith's energy emissions plummeted. Perhaps we could devise a way to reestablish contact with the Monolith.

descriptions.zh:
我们成功地复现了第一次低语呢喃时的条件，开启了与金字塔的第二次交流。这次，我们成功地维持了这一现象，并且与一个远在他处利用方尖碑作为媒介的实体进行了接触。

该实体称自己为§Y凝望者§!，声称自己身处§Y虚境§!之内，是在另一个次元利用金字塔进行交流。它以能量为食，同意为我们提供一些帮助来交换供养。
descriptions.en:
We successfully recreated the conditions of the first Murmuring, and initiated a second communion with the Monolith. This time we have been able to sustain the phenomenon and have established contact with an entity who is using the Monolith as a conduit to reach out from another location.

The entity has identified itself as §YThe Beholder§!. It claims to exist within the §YShroud§!, and uses the Monolith to reach out from a different plane of existence. It feeds on energy, and has agreed to offer us assistance in exchange for a feast.

label.en: Feed it the energy it needs.

label.zh: 我们之后会给你能量的，放心吧。
label.en: It will have energy, over time.

label.zh: 我们之后会给你能量的，放心吧。
label.en: It will have energy, over time.

label.zh: 我们之后会给你能量的，放心吧。
label.en: It will have energy, over time.
We have no reason to trust it.

descriptions.zh:
§H我们按要求提供了能量，完成了和凝望者的交易。能量刚一交付，金字塔就开始发出高频振动。随后它开始摇晃，周围地面开始坍塌。随着巨石上升，它的整体逐渐显露，我们才发现它的本体至少比我们最离谱的估计还要再大上两倍之多。

这座金字塔是一座巨大的八面体结构，它悬浮到了空中，掩盖其上的尘土徐徐落下。随着它飞向[beholder_planet.GetName]大气层的深处，行星的当地居民痛苦地尖叫了起来。

现在我们知道了，低语金字塔是一座拥有太空航行能力的硕大无朋的舰船。它现在正环绕着[beholder_planet.GetName]。§!
descriptions.en:
§HWe fulfilled our end of the bargain with the Beholder, delivering the energy as requested. Upon receipt of the power, the Monolith began emitting high-frequency vibrations. It then began shaking, and the ground surrounding it crumbled, as the Monolith rose, revealing itself to be at least two times larger than even our most outlandish estimates.

A huge octahedral structure, the Monolith was suspended in the air as dirt and dust fell to the ground. The inhabitants of the planet screeched in panic as it took to the skies, climbing high into the atmosphere of [beholder_planet.GetName].

It is now clear that the Murmuring Monolith is a colossal vessel, capable of spaceflight. It currently orbits [beholder_planet.GetName].§!

tooltips.en: §YThe Beholder§! joins your Empire as a §HLeader§!

§H有人尝试与我们建立通讯。§!

§H我们听到了远处湍急的流水、小型飞禽发出呱噪的叫声又扑棱扑棱地飞走。这份通讯似乎来自一个非常繁茂的生物群系。§!
descriptions.en:
§HSomeone is trying to establish contact with us.§!

§HWe hear the rush of flowing liquid in the distance, and the squawking and wing-flapping of tiny avians taking flight. The transmission seems to be coming from a thriving biome.§!

descriptions.zh:
§H又有人尝试联络我们。§!

§H我们又一次听到了之前生物群系的声音。但还是没有任何人出现。§!
descriptions.en:
§HSomeone is attempting to contact us again.§!

§HWe hear the sounds of the biome from earlier. Still, nobody is present.§!

label.en: Trace the source of the transmission.

label.en: This is a waste of time.

descriptions.zh: 我们可以定位这个神秘通讯的源头。通过信号的追踪我们发现了许多不同的坐标点，我们确定这是来自一个移动物体上的通讯。我们的理论认为我们应该是与一艘舰船发生了通讯，一艘可能用于自然保留地之类作用的舰船。
descriptions.en: We were able to locate the source of the mysterious transmissions. On tracing the signals to multiple points of origin, we have ascertained they must be coming from a moving object. Our leading theory suggests we were contacted by a ship, which may be used as a nature reserve of sorts.

descriptions.zh:
§H我们建立了通讯，然后再一次听到了那个生物群系熟悉的声音。然而，这次我们听到了人的说话声，§!

诚挚地向你们问好，[owner.GetAdjective]！我对你们有所期待。原谅我的唐突，但我必须知道你们有多少好奇心。现在让我问你一件事。你们如何看待生命?
descriptions.en:
§HWe establish communication, and are met with the now familiar sounds of the biome. However, this time we hear someone speaking,§!

Warm greetings, [owner.GetAdjective]! I've been expecting you. Pardon the pretense, but I had to know how curious you were. Now let me ask you something. How do you value life?

label.zh: 那要看情况。毕竟生命有很多不同的形式。
label.en: That depends. Life comes in many forms.

label.zh: 这是什么脑筋急转弯吗？

options.script:
name = paragon.208.d
response_text = paragon.208.d.response

name = paragon.208.e

descriptions.zh:
挺合理的回答。几乎所有人都会毫不犹豫地摘除可能危及自己生命的东西。但是我们要记住，所有的生命都有无限的潜力。

现在，我来解释一下我联系你的原因。
descriptions.en:
A sensible answer. Few would hesitate to remove something that would threaten life. Yet, it bears remembering that all life holds infinite potential.

Now, I will shed some light on my reason for contacting you.

descriptions.zh:
§H这位植物类叹了口气。§!

终于见到了一个脑子里不只想着征服的民族。我也有同感，所有的生命都有无限的潜力。

现在，请允许我解释一下我联系您的原因。
descriptions.en:
§HThe plantoid sighs.§!

At last, a people with more than conquest on their minds. I share your sentiment. All life holds infinite potential.

Now, allow me to explain my reason for contacting you.

descriptions.zh:
我叫§Y艾莎琳§!，是来自艾莎提亚的一位前太空生物学家 后来成为了太空创生学者。我一直寻找可以创造新生命的材料。太空创生学需要的能量远超过我自己所能产生的。

§H艾莎琳顿了顿，继续说道§!

请相信我，这是物有所值的。但一开始有些困难。我想先送你一份礼物，看看你能否中和它。
descriptions.en:
I am §YAzaryn§!, a former astrobiologist from Azathea turned scholar of astrocreation. I seek the materials needed to create new life. Astrocreation requires more energy than I can generate on my own.

§HAzaryn pauses before continuing,§!

I assure you, this is a worthwhile pursuit. But first, a challenge. I would like to send you a gift of sorts. See if you are able to neutralize it.

descriptions.zh:

I assure you, this is a worthwhile pursuit. But first, a challenge. I would like to send you a gift of sorts. See if you are able to neutralize it.

descriptions.zh:
我们对艾莎琳的有机“礼物”取得了一定的进展。跨学科科学进步日益增长的潜力令人鼓舞。

我们整理好了目前为止的发现，消除了该微生物的任何潜在威胁，并准备好再次联系艾莎琳。
descriptions.en:
We have made progress with Azaryn's organic 'gift'. The growing potential for interdisciplinary scientific advancement is encouraging.

We have collated our findings, having neutralized any potential threat from the microorganism, and we are ready to contact Azaryn again.

descriptions.zh:
§H艾莎琳听到我们的进展非常开心。§!

太棒了！我非常感激，并为你们的努力喝彩。那么，[owner.GetName]，我还有另一个问题。

你会为了逃避死亡而夺取另一个人的生命吗？
descriptions.en:
§HAzaryn is delighted to hear of our breakthrough.§!

Wonderful! I appreciate and applaud your efforts. Now, [owner.GetName], I have another question.

To escape death, would you take the life of another?

descriptions.zh:
确实，大多数人都会这么选。毕竟生存是所有生物的驱动力。理解并接受这个事实也许有一天能拯救你，还有你的良心。

在我的下一个请求之前，我还有一件礼物要给你们。这是艾莎提亚大王花，是一种我的舰船上原生的花卉。我给你的挑战是让它开花。暂时再会了。
descriptions.en:
Indeed, most would. Survival is the driving force of all living things, after all. Understanding and accepting that fact might save you one day, and your conscience.

Before my next query, I have another gift for you. It is a Rafflesia Azathea, a type of flower, native to my ship. I challenge you to make it bloom. Farewell, for now.

descriptions.zh:
真的，你们真的不会吗？

§H艾莎琳挠了挠头。§!

我觉得这让人有点沮丧，也不可信。虽然我觉得这在某种程度上是令人钦佩的。要是这是真的就好了。

在我的下一个请求之前，我还有一件礼物要给你们。这是艾莎提亚大王花，是一种我的舰船上原生的花卉。我给你的挑战是让它开花。暂时再会了。
descriptions.en:
Truly, you would not?

§HAzaryn scratches her head.§!

I find that discouraging, and rather unconvincing. Although I suppose it's admirable in a way. If only it were true.

Before my next query, I have another gift for you. It is a Rafflesia Azathea, a type of flower, native to my ship. I challenge you to make it bloom. Farewell, for now.

options.script:
name = paragon.218.a
enable_special_project = { name = AZARYNS_RAFFLESIA_PROJECT }

descriptions.zh: 我们最初试图引起花苞的反应，但效果并不好。只有当使用超出通常安全参数的电刺激时，这朵花才能开放。我们已经完成了艾莎琳的最新任务，并准备再次与她联系。
descriptions.en: Our initial attempts to provoke a reaction from the flower bud were underwhelming. It was only when we applied electrical stimuli beyond our usual safety parameters that we were able to bring the flower to bloom. We have completed Azaryn's latest task, and are ready to contact her again.

descriptions.zh:
§H一只小巧的授粉无人机在艾莎琳的脑边嗡嗡作响。她温柔地把它挥开。§!

再次问好。艾莎提亚大王花真是一种有趣的植物，你们也赞同吧？进化真是一件奇妙的事情。我对于你们能对其施加合适量的能量来使其盛开感到印象深刻。

§H她兴奋地拍起了手。§!

又到了提问时间。在规模都很大的前提下，你们会为了拯救其他的生命而牺牲自己的同类吗？
descriptions.en:
§HA tiny pollination drone buzzes around Azaryn's head. She gently wafts it away.§!

Hello again. The Rafflesia Azathea sure is an interesting plant, wouldn't you agree? Evolution truly is a wondrous thing. I'm impressed you were able to apply the required amount of energy to make it bloom.

§HShe claps her hands excitedly.§!

Time for another question. Would you sacrifice your own kind if it meant you could save lives elsewhere, on a massive scale?

descriptions.zh:
§H艾莎琳心领神会地点了点头。§!

是的，也许这个答案很明显，但在那个场景之下，可能很难看到正确答案。我们必须抛下自己的情感，做出那些顾全大局的事情。

我再问你们最后一个问题。

你们在消灭威胁的时候会有任何迟疑吗？
descriptions.en:
§HAzaryn nods in understanding.§!

Yes, it may seem the obvious choice but, when caught up in the moment, it can be very hard to see it through. We must set aside our emotions and do what is best for the greater good.

I have one final question for you.

Would you hesitate to remove a threat?

descriptions.zh:
§H艾莎琳同情地点了点头。§!

确实，这不是一件容易的事。我赞许你们的诚实。

然而我相信，为了顾全大局，智慧生命必须给那些无私的选择以更高的优先级。

我再问你们最后一个问题。

你们在消灭威胁的时候会有任何迟疑吗？
descriptions.en:
§HAzaryn nods sympathetically.§!

Indeed, it is not an easy thing to do. I appreciate your honesty.

However, it is my belief that for the betterment of all, intelligent life must always give precedence to the selfless choice.

I have one final question for you.

Would you hesitate to remove a threat?

label.zh: 没错。决定性的行为确实需要三思。

descriptions.zh:
你喜欢有时间思考。不幸的是，有时间思考可是一种特权。决定是一定有做出的，而片刻的深思熟虑可能是成功与失败的区别。

§H艾莎琳沉默片刻，然后给出了结论：§!

很好，我已经问了你们够多问题了。你们给予了我非常多的耐心。我会花一点时间收集这些信息。我们很快会再一次谈话的。
descriptions.en:
Ah, you like having time to think. Unfortunately, one does not always have the privilege of extra time. Decisions must be made, and a moment of deliberation could be the difference between success and failure.

§HAzaryn is quiet for a moment. Then concludes:§!

Well, I have asked you enough questions. You possess admirable patience. I will take some time to collate this information. We shall speak again soon.

descriptions.zh:
我同意。果断很重要，但有些情况需要额外考虑。有时候你并不总是那么幸运，能够马上获得所有必要的信息。耐心对你大有好处。

§H艾莎琳沉默片刻，然后给出了结论：§!

很好，我已经问了你们够多问题了。你们给予了我非常多的耐心。我会花一点时间收集这些信息。我们很快会再一次谈话的。
descriptions.en:
I agree. Decisiveness is vital, but some situations require extra consideration. Sometimes you are not fortunate enough to have all of the necessary information right away. Patience could benefit you greatly.

§HAzaryn is quiet for a moment. Then concludes:§!

Well, I have asked you enough questions. You possess admirable patience. I will take some time to collate this information. We shall speak again soon.

options.script: name = GOODBYE

descriptions.zh:
啊，[owner.GetAdjective]。诚挚地向你们问好。我的结论是，你们是太空创生学杰出的继承人！

§H艾莎琳微笑着。§!

我们将携手将生命播撒向虚空。我们将携手为所有人带去希望！

 只要你努力创造新生命，我的技能和我的船愿为你所用。如果你喜欢，我很乐意加入你。
descriptions.en:
Ah, [owner.GetAdjective]. Warm greetings. I have concluded that you are an excellent advocate for astrocreation!

§HAzaryn smiles.§!

Together we shall breathe life into the void. Together, we shall inspire hope for all!

As long as you strive to create new life, my skills and my ship are at your disposal. If this pleases you, I will gladly join you.

descriptions.zh:
你好，[owner.GetAdjective]。很高兴再次见到你们。

尽管我们有许多的不同，但我希望你们能记得我的教导，并学会用创生学的知识造福星系。

 只要你努力创造新生命，我的技能和我的船愿为你所用。如果你喜欢，我很乐意加入你。
descriptions.en:
Hello, [owner.GetAdjective]. I am pleased to see you again.

Despite our differences, it is my hope that you will embrace my teaching, and learn to utilize astrocreation for the good of the galaxy.

As long as you strive to create new life, my skills and my ship are at your disposal. If this pleases you, I will gladly join you.

descriptions.zh:
你好！你们已经向我展示了你们的实力。我希望能适时教会你们利用我的太空创生之力。

§H艾莎琳鞠了一躬。§!

我们会携手让星系再度变得郁郁葱葱。 只要你努力创造新生命，我的技能和我的船愿为你所用。如果你喜欢，我很乐意加入你。
descriptions.en:
Hello again! You have proven your potential. In time I hope to teach you to utilize my astrocreation powers.

§HAzaryn bows.§!

Together, we will reinvigorate the galaxy.As long as you strive to create new life, my skills and my ship are at your disposal. If this pleases you, I will gladly join you.

tooltips.zh: §H太空创生家艾莎琳§!作为一位§Y领袖§!加入了我们帝国。
tooltips.en: §YAstrocreator Azaryn§! joins our Empire as a §HLeader§!.

descriptions.zh:
§H艾莎琳正在控制台上飞快地输入着，调节着一些仪器。§!

太棒了！我定位了你的首都开始导航，很快就能到你们那儿。

欧我差点忘了，我舰船的生态系统也是许多外激素的家。 为了纪念此刻的愉悦，请接收这份§Y信息素§!作为礼物。里面包含了一些可以为你的人民带去好处的化合物。很值得一用。
descriptions.en:
§HTyping quickly into a command console, Azaryn adjusts some instruments.§!

Wonderful! I have plotted a course for your capital, and will be arriving shortly.

Oh, and before I forget, my ship's ecosystem is home to a wide variety of ectohormones. To mark this joyous occasion, please accept this gift of §Ypheromones§!. They contain a potent compound which will bring certain benefits to your people. It is well deserved.

descriptions.zh:
§H艾莎琳正在控制台上飞快地输入着，调节着一些仪器。§!

太棒了！我定位了你的首都开始导航，很快就能到你们那儿。

欧我差点忘了，我舰船的生态系统也是许多外激素的家。 为了纪念我们的合作，我准备了一份§Y信息素§!作为礼物。这不是我最杰出的工作，但还是会为你们的人民带来一些正面的效果。
descriptions.en:
§HTyping quickly into a command console, Azaryn adjusts some instruments.§!

Wonderful! I have plotted a course for your capital, and will be arriving shortly.

Oh, and before I forget, my ship's ecosystem is home to a wide variety of ectohormones. To commemorate our collaboration, I have prepared a gift of §Ypheromones§!. It's not my best work, but they will provide some positive effects to your people.

descriptions.zh:
§H艾莎琳正在控制台上飞快地输入着，调节着一些仪器。§!

太棒了！我定位了你的首都开始导航，很快就能到你们那儿。

欧我差点忘了，我舰船的生态系统也是许多外激素的家。 感觉我给你这些§Y信息素§!应该挺合适的。它们与你们的物种可以兼容，一定能提供一些正面效果的。
descriptions.en:
§HTyping quickly into a command console, Azaryn adjusts some instruments.§!

Wonderful! I have plotted a course for your capital, and will be arriving shortly.

Oh, and before I forget, my ship's ecosystem is home to a wide variety of ectohormones. It seems appropriate I give you these §Ypheromones§!. They are compatible with your species, and are sure to provide some positive effects.

descriptions.zh: §Y太空创生家艾莎琳§!的健康情况肉眼可见地恶化了。她拒绝接受检查，所以我们什么都帮不上。
descriptions.en: §YAstrocreator Azaryn§!'s health has visibly declined. She refuses to be examined, so we are unable to help her.

options.script: name = paragon.232.a

descriptions.zh: 我们现在确信§Y太空创生家艾莎琳§!的健康与环境改造之核密不可分。每用掉一个核心，她的健康状况就变糟糕一分，我们猜测一旦用掉最后一个核，她将会死去。
descriptions.en: We now know for certain that §YAstrocreator Azaryn§!'s health is inherently tied to her Terraformation Nuclei. Her condition worsened after each use, and we now suspect that upon seeding her final Nuclei, she will die.

options.script: name = paragon.235.a

descriptions.zh:
§H太空创生家艾莎琳还在。她舰船上日常的叽叽喳喳变成了一种低沉的哼鸣。她用一种暗哑的声音低语。§!

我并不悲伤。那些星球会欣欣向荣的，我很荣幸献出了自己的生命。谢谢你们，朋友。

§H她走了。§!
descriptions.en:
§HAstrocreator Azaryn is still. The usual cacophony of sound from her ship has fallen to a low hum. She speaks in a strained whisper.§!

I am not sad. So worlds may thrive, I have gladly given my life. Thank you, friends.

§HShe is gone.§!

descriptions.zh:
§H我们收到了一份预先录制的信息。是来自艾莎琳的。§!

虽然我接纳了自己的牺牲，但我无法接受生息之所以及船上的万物和我一起死去的这件事。这艘舰船与我紧密相连，当我枯萎时，它也会枯萎。

我对此有所预见，所以生息之所是以模块化设计的，其中的每个生态系统都能够自我维持。准备工作已经都提前做好了，你们只需要找到一颗行星重新把栖息地安置下来。我相信你们能完成这项任务。
descriptions.en:
§HWe receive a pre-recorded message. It is from Azaryn.§!

Although I accept my sacrifice, I cannot stand the thought of the Vivarium and the lifeforms on board dying with me. The ship is profoundly linked to me, and when I wither, it will too.

In anticipation of this, I designed the Vivarium in a modular fashion, with each ecosystem capable of sustaining itself. Preparations have been made, and all you need to do is find a planet to rehome the habitat. I trust you to complete this task.

tooltips.en: Preparations for the relocation and reconstruction of Azaryn's §YContained Ecosphere§! have been made. It may be reconstructed on a planet of our choosing.

descriptions.zh:
我们的一位科学家自行从§Y太空创生家艾莎琳§!的环境改造之核上悄悄取下的一份样本。

对该花苞的研究可以提供一些现阶段艾莎琳还没打算分享的有价值的信息。
descriptions.en:
Acting of their own volition, one of our scientists has covertly obtained a sample from one of §YAstrocreator Azaryn§!'s Terraformation Nuclei.

Researching this bud could provide valuable information which Azaryn does not seem inclined to share at this stage.

descriptions.zh:
§H太空创生家艾莎琳松了口气。§!

你们能决定将这个还给我，我的感激之情无法言表。如果不能正确控制这种力量，结果可能是灾难性的。

值得庆幸的是，历史不会重演。为了奖励你的诚实，我会准备一批新的费洛蒙。
descriptions.en:
§HAstrocreator Azaryn is relieved.§!

I cannot understate my gratitude that you have seen fit to return this. Without the proper means to control this power, the results could have been catastrophic.

Thankfully, history will not repeat itself. To reward your honesty, I will prepare a fresh batch of pheromones.

descriptions.en: Our covert science team has been able to learn a lot from studying the sample of §YAstrocreator Azaryn§!'s nucleus. This project has concluded successfully, and Azaryn is none the wiser.

label.zh: 我们必须坦白。联络艾莎琳。
label.en: We must come clean. Contact Azaryn.

tooltips.en: There is a small chance §YAstrocreator Azaryn§! will end our collaboration.

descriptions.zh:
§H艾莎琳有点惊讶。§!

欧，嗨！很高兴见到你！

不得不承认，我们合作带来的好处比我预想的要多得多。我们正在一起大步迈进。这样的事情只有我们互相信任才能实现。

§H她亲切地微笑着。§!
descriptions.en:
§HAzaryn is surprised.§!

 Oh, hello. Good to see you!

I must say this partnership is proving a greater boon than I would have imagined. We are making great strides together. Such things are only possible with trust.

§HShe smiles warmly.§!

label.en: We need to tell you something.

descriptions.zh:
我知道了。

§H她叹了口气。§!

行吧，损失已经发生了。幸好你们这么快就来联络我了。我们必须迅速行动。这需要你方大量的投入。有多少就拿出来多少，这样我们可以尽快结束掉这个问题。
descriptions.en:
I see.

§HShe sighs.§!

Well, the damage is done. It is lucky you contacted me sooner rather than later. We must act quickly. This will require a significant investment on your part. Give me what you can so we may end this.

tooltips.zh: 艾莎琳拿走了你全部的£energy£§H能量币§!。

descriptions.zh: 我们研究环境改造之核样本的研究设施被毁了。由于一直无法阻止入侵性植物的蔓延，现在，新盛开的植物群正在释放出能引起皮肤起泡的花粉，这种花粉一旦吸入后果是致命的。这让[event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName]危在旦夕。
descriptions.en: The research facility where we were studying the Terraformation Nuclei sample has been devastated. We have been unable to stop the spread of invasive plant life. Now, the freshly bloomed flora are emitting skin-blistering pollen, which is highly toxic if inhaled. This puts [event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName] at risk.

label.zh: 我们控制不住了。联络艾莎琳。
label.en: We cannot contain this. Contact Azaryn.

tooltips.zh: §Y太空创生家艾莎琳§!有可能会终止我们的合作。
tooltips.en: There is a small chance §YAstrocreator Azaryn§! will end our collaboration.

descriptions.zh:
§H太空创生家艾莎琳非常地沮丧。§!

我早知道了你们的贪婪，但我没想到你们竟还如此狂妄，甚至将自己人民的安危置于不顾。他们已经岌岌可危了！

我正在为这个过度增生准备应对措施。但是因为你的玩忽职守造成的伤者需要紧急治疗。
descriptions.en:
§HAstrocreator Azaryn is crestfallen.§!

I knew you were greedy, but I did not expect you to be so proud that you would risk hurting your own people. They are dying!

I am preparing countermeasures to end this rampant growth. But the victims of your negligence will require immediate medical treatment.

label.zh: 我们会好好照顾他们的。
label.en: We will take care of them.

descriptions.zh:
在长长的游行队伍中，§Y[From.GetName]§!静静地沉眠，§Y[Root.GetName]§!的每一位公民都受邀前来表示敬意。

葬礼之后是为期一周的盛大祭典，祭典花费巨大。§Y[From.GetName]§!的透明水晶棺材在§Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!纪念堂展出。人群排在街头，想要一睹他们伟大领袖的最终安息之处。
descriptions.en:
§Y[From.GetName]§! has been laid to rest following a public procession. Every citizen of §Y[Root.GetName]§! was invited to pay their respects.

The funeral is followed by a week-long festival, with no expenses spared. §Y[From.GetName]§!'s translucent crystal casket is displayed at the §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§! memorial site, where the crowds line the streets hoping to catch a glimpse of the great leader in their final resting place.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!在最亲近的亲属和同事的环绕中静静地沉眠。其对§Y[Root.GetName]§!的贡献不菲，但现在并不是能铺张浪费的时候。
descriptions.en: §Y[From.GetName]§! is laid to rest in a private ceremony with their closest family members and colleagues. Their contribution to the §Y[Root.GetName]§! was an important one, but now is not the time for exorbitant expenditure.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们对§Y[From.GetTitle]§!§Y[From.GetName]§!的谨慎处置被媒体迅速捕捉到了。尽管一些人表达了担忧，但许多消息来源还是坚定地指出了这位领袖的缺点。当前的普遍看法是，我们终于可以找一位更合适的继任者来替代现在这位领袖了。
descriptions.en: The discreet disposal of our §Y[From.GetTitle]§!, §Y[From.GetName]§!, has been promptly noted by the press. While others express concern, many sources adamantly point out the leader's shortcomings. The general sentiment is relief that we can now replace this leader with a more fitting successor.

label.en: It is time to move on.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
在一场简短的追悼会后，[From.GetTitle]的遗体被捐赠给了科学界，以对基础医药研究和教育继续做贡献。

这些过程中剩下的东西最终将被水火化，变成富含矿物质的肥料，确保身体的任何部分都不会被浪费。
descriptions.en:
After a brief commemoration, the [From.GetTitle]'s body has been donated to science to contribute towards essential medical research and education.

What is left from these procedures will in the end be water cremated and turned into a mineral-rich fertilizer, ensuring no part of the body goes to waste.

label.en: Such is the cycle of life.

descriptions.zh:
人们聚集在一起，追悼§Y[From.GetName]§!的一生及其丰功伟绩。人们挤满了街道，向东望不见头，向西望不见尾。颂歌一直唱到了夜幕降临。[From.GetHeSheCap]现在已经跨入彼岸。

[From.GetHisHer]的布道节选现在在整个帝国回荡，提醒着我们共同的目标。
descriptions.en:
The people gathered in their masses to celebrate the life and career of §Y[From.GetName]§!. Huge processions filled the streets, and hymns were sung long into the night. [From.GetHeSheCap] is now waiting for us on the other side of the veil.

Popular excerpts from [From.GetHisHer] sermons are now reverberating across the empire, reminding us of our common goal.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
大型阅兵方阵和舰队护卫着§Y[From.GetName]§!的灵柩前往最终安息之地。[From.GetHisHerCap]的遗体被发射去了最近的恒星，并全程向全社会广播。

逝世领袖的个人战略部署和日志成为了下一批军校学员课程中的内容。
descriptions.en:
A huge parade of troops and a flyover by naval forces marked the arrival of §Y[From.GetName]§!'s casket to its final resting place. [From.GetHisHerCap] body was fired into the nearest star during a society-wide broadcast.

The departed leader's personal strategies and log books will become a part of the curriculum for the next generation of cadets.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 为了纪念刚刚去世的伟大§Y[From.GetTitle]§!，§Y[From.GetName]§!，我们设立了一个非盈利的基金会。这个基金会标志着星际的和平与和谐发展迈出了一步，包容了不同社群和物种之间的分歧。
descriptions.en: A non-profit foundation has been established to honor the passing of the great §Y[From.GetTitle]§!, §Y[From.GetName]§!. The foundation marks a step towards peace and interstellar harmony, bridging differences between communities and species.

label.zh: 我们共同创造了一项遗产。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
当§Y[From.GetName]§!去世的消息传遍更远的地区时，一种深深的悲痛笼罩了整个帝国。无数的哀悼者遵循传统的葬礼仪式加入了§Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!的葬礼队伍中。

其遗体被一丝不苟地清洁并进行了适当的装饰。在§Y[From.GetTitle]§!的遗体进行了安葬之前，我们全国上下都要默哀，表示尊重。
descriptions.en:
A deep sorrow has gripped the public as news regarding the passing of §Y[From.GetName]§! spreads to the wider community. Countless mourners join the funeral procession on §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§! to follow the traditional funeral rites.

The body is meticulously cleansed and appropriately decorated. Before the deceased §Y[From.GetTitle]§! is laid to rest, a moment of silence is observed throughout our systems as a mark of respect.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
为纪念§Y[From.GetName]§!一生的丰功伟绩，我们为[From.GetHimHer]准备了一场穿越星海的最后航行。

一个容纳着[From.GetTitle]遗体的胶囊被庄严地发射向未探索的宇域，伴随他的还有诗歌、图表、录音和其他贵宾带来的随葬品。将来有一天，[From.GetTitle]的船只可能会在那里找到一个新家，完成[From.GetHisHer]的最后任务。
descriptions.en:
The remarkable deeds of §Y[From.GetName]§! have warranted [From.GetHimHer] one last voyage through space.

A capsule containing the [From.GetTitle]'s remains is ceremonially launched into the void alongside poems, charts, recordings, and other memorabilia brought by various dignitaries. One day the [From.GetTitle]'s vessel may find a new home out there, completing [From.GetHisHer] final mission.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 工匠们获得最好的材料来制作§Y[From.GetName]§!的肖像，将其加入到§Y[Root.GetName]§!传奇英雄的行列中。其庄严的面孔被蚀刻在石头和金属上，让人们牢记这位强大领袖的丰功伟绩。
descriptions.en: Artisans have been provided with the finest materials to fashion the likeness of §Y[From.GetName]§!, adding them to the long line of storied heroes of the §Y[Root.GetName]§!. Their majestic visage is etched in stone and metal, acting as a reminder of what strong leaders can accomplish.

label.zh: 您的伟大将被永远铭记。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!的名字与头衔被镌刻在了一座高大耸立的纪念碑上，与无数其他为§Y[Root.GetName]§!的人民鞠躬尽瘁的人们并列。这位备受尊敬的§Y[From.GetTitle]§!将被人民永远铭记，他的贡献为未来数代领袖们开拓道路。
descriptions.en: §Y[From.GetName]§!'s name and title are carved on a towering monument alongside others who have served the §Y[Root.GetName]§! for the good of its population. The respected §Y[From.GetTitle]§! will be fondly remembered by the people, paving the way for future generations of leaders.

label.en: For the good of the many.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
这位领袖的去世引起了星际证交所短暂但剧烈的震荡。

除了举办奢华的葬礼，§Y[Root.GetName]§!还将一座较高的摩天楼重命名为[From.GetName]大厦以确保以后这位[From.GetTitle]的名字会被写入公司的编年史中。每间会议室的墙上都挂着一幅经过艺术诠释的肖像，以纪念其对帝国的杰出贡献。
descriptions.en:
News of the leader's passing is met with a sharp, but brief downturn in share value at the galactic stock markets.

In addition to sponsoring the lavish funeral, §Y[Root.GetName]§! rebrands one of its taller skyscrapers as the [From.GetName] Building to ensure that the late [From.GetTitle]'s name is preserved in the annals of the corporate history. An artistically interpreted portrait is also hung on every boardroom wall to commemorate their outstanding contributions to the empire.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
§Y[From.Species.GetName]§!的去世并不像表面上看起来那么彻底。尽管躯干已经开始劣化，但核心还可以恢复活力。

在浸泡过一种特殊的激素溶液后，§Y[From.GetName]§!的遗体被小心翼翼地埋入§Y[burial_planet.GetName]§!的土壤中。埋葬地由孵化者精心照料，他们耐心地等待幼体破土发芽，开始新的循环。
descriptions.en:
The death of a §Y[From.Species.GetName]§! is not as final as it appears. Even if the main stem has begun to deteriorate, the roots can be reinvigorated.

After soaking in a special hormone solution, §Y[From.GetName]§!'s remains are carefully buried in the soil of §Y[burial_planet.GetName]§!. The burial site is tended by brood members who patiently await for younglings to sprout on the surface, starting the cycle anew.

label.en: From one life to the next.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
§Y[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]§!在可靠地服务了[From.GetYearsOfService]后发生了故障，彻底报废。我们的科学家已经备份了文件以保留重要数据。

基于§Y[From.GetName]§!的智能全息图谱已经被安装在我们的舰船系统中，作为虚拟顾问为我们服务。他们将继续支援我们的任务。
descriptions.en:
§Y[From.GetTitle] [From.GetName]§! has broken down after [From.GetYearsOfService] of reliable service. Our scientists have backed up their files to preserve important data.

An intelligent hologram based on §Y[From.GetName]§! has been installed in our ship systems to serve as a virtual advisor. They will continue to aid in our mission.

label.zh: 死亡不再是一项障碍了。
label.en: Death is no longer an obstacle.

descriptions.zh: §Y[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]§!的意识在[From.GetAge]岁时从集体意识中移除。我们是§Y[Root.GetName]§!，我们将永存。
descriptions.en: The mind of §Y[From.GetTitle] [From.GetName]§! was removed from the collective at the age of [From.GetAge]. We are the §Y[Root.GetName]§!. We will endure.

is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
一开始只是些许小小的争吵，现在已经演变成在每一项议题前都争论不休的僵局，这严重阻碍了我们内阁的运转效率。

§Y[root.GetName]§!是内阁中最热衷于争吵和扰乱秩序的问题成员。许多人要求免去[root.GetHisHer]的席位，以恢复秩序和效率。
descriptions.en:
What began as minor bickering has now devolved into quarrelsome gridlock on practically every issue brought before the Council, damaging its ability to function.

§Y[root.GetName]§! has proven to be the most contentious and disruptive member of the Council. Many others are calling for [root.GetHisHer] removal so that order and efficiency can be restored.

label.zh: 他们必须学会协同工作。
label.en: They must learn to work together.

descriptions.zh: 一种罕见的宇宙现象的壮观促使§Y[root.GetName]§!达到了新的高度。兴奋和新想法席卷而来，唯一的问题是应该专注于哪个科学分支。
descriptions.en: The majesty of a rarely seen cosmic phenomenon has spurred §Y[root.GetName]§! to new heights. Brimming with excitement and new ideas, the only question is what branch of science they should focus on.

label.zh: 我们的工程师们应该更懂得怎么利用它。
label.en: Our engineers know exactly what to do with this.

descriptions.zh: 在§Y[root.GetName]§!富有冒险精神的亲自部署、亲自指挥下，我们查获了大批违禁品。这次行动酝酿了很长时间，其成功地削弱了在我国境内扎根的有组织的犯罪集团。
descriptions.en: Under the audacious regime of §Y[root.GetName]§!, we have accumulated a huge cache of seized contraband. The operation was a long time in the making, and its successful conclusion has crippled the organized crime syndicates that had taken root within our borders.

descriptions.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!展现出了非凡的领导能力，将内阁团结了起来，确保了对我们社会的高效管理。充分运用统计学、传统和外交手段，[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]成功地安抚了内阁的其他成员，以及我们社会中的各个派系。
descriptions.en: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§! has demonstrated  incredible leadership by uniting the council and ensuring the efficient administration of our society. Making use of statistics, tradition, and diplomacy, [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has managed to appease not only the other council members, but also our society's numerous factions.

label.zh: 携手共进，我们就会更加强大。
label.en: We are stronger when we work together.

descriptions.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!以自我发现和发展为目的开始了一段旅程。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的专心学习、刻苦钻研和善于自省，让[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的心智能力达到了一个全新的高度。现在，[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]决心挑战可能性的界限，并激励其他人去采摘星辰。
descriptions.en: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§! has embarked on a journey of self-discovery and personal development. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] mental capabilities have reached new heights as a result of [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] focused study, hard work and introspection. Now, [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] is determined to push the boundaries of what is possible and inspire others to reach for the stars.

descriptions.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!令人震惊的科学发现直接导致研究的效率大幅提高。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的发现在科学圈中成了热门课题，他们现在将[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]视为思想领袖。
descriptions.en: As a direct result of §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!'s astounding scientific discoveries, the rate at which we conduct research has accelerated. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] findings are a hot topic in the scientific community, which now recognizes [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] as a thought leader.

label.zh: 这些发展会让所有人收益。

descriptions.zh:
我们发生了一次严重的信息泄露事故，许多敏感信息和关键的安保细节被公之于众。这些文件包含军事设施的编成表、神经交互界面实验、以及对几位重要的反对派人物的监视。

§Y[root.GetName]§!在这次灾难事件中难辞其咎。
descriptions.en:
A significant data leak has occurred, exposing sensitive information and crucial security details to the public. The files include schematics of military installations, details of neural interface experiments, and proof of surveillance of several prominent figures in the opposition.

§Y[root.GetName]§! has been identified as the one responsible for this disaster.

descriptions.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!成为了一位对普罗大众而言的潮流开创者。从[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的穿着风格到[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的说话方式，一切都吸引了大批追随者。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的影响力扩展到了各个社会经济阶层，但[event_target:leader_event_target.GetSheHe]果然还是在年轻人中最受欢迎。
descriptions.en: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§! has become a trendsetter among the general population. Everything from [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] style to [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] method of speech has attracted a sizable following. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] reach extends across all socioeconomic strata, but [event_target:leader_event_target.GetSheHe] has proven particularly popular among the youth.

label.en: We have no reason not to support this.

descriptions.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!发表的热情洋溢的演讲在掀起了一股爱国狂潮。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的赤子之心唤醒了我们全境内的责任感与民族热忱。
descriptions.en: The public have been swept up into a patriotic frenzy following a passionate speech delivered by §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] unbridled passion has heightened the sense of responsibility and nationalistic zeal that is now being felt throughout our territories.

descriptions.zh:
统计分析表明§Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!已经发展出认知和行为上的很大程度的异质性，使其趋近于一个独立个体。

我们无法准确预测自由意志的危害和潜在益处。现在必须作出决定：[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]应该保持现在的状态，还是应该强迫其回归正轨？
descriptions.en:
Statistical analysis has confirmed that §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§! has developed cognitive and behavioral idiosyncrasies of a magnitude that verge on the individual.

The risks and potential benefits of independent thought are beyond our ability to accurately predict. A decision has to be made: will [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] be kept in this state, or should we force a correctional routine?

label.zh: 把个体性抑制在萌芽状态。

descriptions.zh:
§Y[root.GetName]§!深陷一场轰动全国的巨大丑闻。关于不当行为，挪用公款和掩盖真相的报道层出不穷，许多人甚至因此质疑起了当权者的能力。

毫无疑问，这些事件对公众情绪的影响还会持续好多年。许多人相信，恢复公信力的唯一手段就是让[root.GetName]下台并接受公审。
descriptions.en:
§Y[root.GetName]§! is at the center of a major scandal reverberating throughout the empire. There are numerous reports of aberrant behavior, embezzlement, and cover-ups. This has led many to question the competence of those in authority.

The effects on the public mood will undoubtedly be felt for years to come. Many believe that the only way to restore faith in the system is for [root.GetName] to step down and face prosecution.
